description: List the Salesforce objects this org can query — Account, Contact, Opportunity, and every custom object — as the options a person picks from. Each option's id is the API name, which is what goes in the FROM clause of salesforce-query_records-1. `query` keeps only the objects whose label or API name contains that text. This is the browse node behind the salesforce sync picker, so its output is the scope-option shape.

parent_id.description: Ignored. Object types are a flat list, so there is nothing to open.

query.description: Keep only objects whose label or API name contains this text, ignoring case.

cursor.description: Ignored. The describe call answers with every object in one response.

limit.description: Ignored. The describe call takes no page size.

next_cursor.description: Always null. Salesforce describes every object in one answer.

response_schema.description: describeGlobal. Lenient on purpose: Salesforce sends about forty booleans per object and adds more each release; this reads the four fields the node needs.

quirks.why_execute: The call host is per connection (see salesforce_api.ts) and the answer is filtered before it is mapped. Neither is expressible as a declarative http mapping.
quirks.id_is_the_api_name: The option id is the API name — Account, Custom_Object__c — because that is what a SOQL FROM clause takes and what salesforce-query_records-1 therefore needs to read back out of sync_scope.
quirks.hidden_objects: An org describes hundreds of objects a person would never sync. Three rules cut the list: not queryable means SOQL cannot read it at all, deprecatedAndHidden means Salesforce itself has retired it, and the AccountShare / AccountHistory / AccountFeed / AccountChangeEvent families are the sharing, audit, chatter and streaming shadows of another object rather than data anyone picks. Everything else stays, custom objects included.
quirks.no_paging: describeGlobal answers with the whole catalogue in one response. next_cursor is always null and the cursor and limit inputs are accepted and ignored, so one generic picker can call every browse node the same way.
quirks.api_version: v61.0, pinned per node version, same as every other Salesforce node here.
